component.name: Comfy Desktop
component.summary: Install, run, and manage ComfyUI from one app

description.p: Comfy Desktop is the official desktop application for ComfyUI, the node-based engine for generative AI. It installs ComfyUI into a self-contained, GPU-ready environment and keeps it updated, so you can focus on building workflows instead of managing Python and CUDA.

ul.li: Run multiple independent ComfyUI installations side by side
Isolated, GPU-ready environments with prebuilt PyTorch and GPU wheels
One-click updates for ComfyUI and custom nodes
Snapshots and rollback for safe experimentation
Adopt and migrate existing ComfyUI installations

screenshot.caption: Run multiple ComfyUI installs side by side
